job.title: GPS Excavator Operator
job.description:
GPS Excavator Operator – Up to 35T

Location: Various sites across Brisbane and surrounding areas
Rate: $50 per hour
Travel Allowance: $22.45, with $50 travel for distances over 60km
Work: Ongoing opportunities with potential for long-term work

About the Role

Aussie Plant Hire is looking for an experienced GPS Excavator Operator to join its team for ongoing civil construction projects across Brisbane and surrounding areas.

The role will involve operating excavators up to 34 tonnes across a variety of civil works, including drainage, working around underground services, bulk earthworks and final trim.

We are looking for an adaptable all-rounder with a positive can-do attitude who can follow instructions, work independently and contribute to a productive site team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate excavators up to 35T with GPS machine control.

  • Carry out bulk earthworks, excavation and final trim.

  • Assist with drainage, trenching and pipework.

  • Work safely around underground services.

  • Support civil construction crews across different projects.

  • Follow site instructions and maintain a safe work environment.

About You

  • Proven experience operating excavators up to 35T.

  • GPS machine control experience, including any of the following:

    • Trimble

    • Topcon

    • Leica

    • MOBA

    • Novatron

    • Unicontrol

    • Other equivalent GPS machine control systems.

  • Experience in drainage, bulk earthworks and final trim.

  • Current White Card and relevant tickets/licences.

  • Reliable, adaptable and safety-conscious.

  • Positive can-do attitude and ability to follow instructions.

What's on Offer

  • $50 per hour.

  • Travel allowance of $22.45, with $50 travel for distances over 60km.

  • Projects across Brisbane and surrounding areas.

  • Ongoing work with potential for long-term opportunities.

  • Variety of civil construction projects.

Join our client’s team and bring your operating skills to projects where accuracy and dependable performance matter.

Interested?

Contact Juliet at Siteforce Recruitment.

job.title: Commercial Site Supervisor - Hervey Bay
job.description:
Site Supervisor – Commercial Construction

Location: Hervey Bay, QLD
Employment Type: 6-month project, with potential for ongoing work
Rate: $65–$75 per hour or subcontractor arrangement, depending on experience

About the Role

Siteforce Recruitment is seeking an experienced, hands-on Site Supervisor to join a locally owned, award-winning construction company delivering commercial construction projects across Queensland. This role will oversee a major project in Hervey Bay, with potential opportunities for further work across the Wide Bay region and Queensland.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage daily construction site operations and coordinate site activities.

  • Supervise construction teams and subcontractors to ensure work is completed safely and efficiently.

  • Monitor project progress, schedules and quality standards.

  • Interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications.

  • Ensure compliance with WHS legislation, site safety procedures and relevant building standards.

  • Conduct site inspections and identify and address safety hazards.

  • Coordinate inspections, quality checks and Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).

  • Maintain accurate site diaries, attendance records and project documentation.

  • Liaise with project managers, subcontractors and client representatives.

  • Identify and resolve site issues proactively to support project delivery.

Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 2–5 years' experience as a Site Supervisor or Project Manager.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering commercial construction projects in Australia.

  • Current QBCC Site Supervisor Licence.

  • Certificate III in Carpentry and/or relevant project management experience.

  • Current First Aid and CPR certifications.

  • Valid White Card (Construction Induction).

  • Strong understanding of WHS, site compliance and construction quality requirements.

  • Excellent leadership, communication and organisational skills.

  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach with a strong commitment to safety and quality.

Project Details and Benefits

  • Initial six-month commercial construction project.

  • Potential for further projects across the Wide Bay region and Queensland.

  • Up to 50–60 hours per week, depending on roster and project requirements.

  • Rate of $65–$75 per hour or subcontractor arrangement, depending on experience.

  • Company vehicle and fuel card allowance.

  • Company iPad or laptop, as required.

  • Five high-visibility work shirts.

  • $80 monthly phone allowance for work-related use of a personal phone.

Location and Eligibility

The role is based onsite in Hervey Bay, Queensland. Local candidates are preferred. Applicants must be willing to relocate at their own expense if required and be based in Hervey Bay for the project.

How to Apply

If you have relevant Australian commercial construction experience and hold the required QBCC licence and safety certifications, please submit your current CV outlining your site supervision experience, project history and qualifications.

Important eligibility requirement:

Applicants must be Australian citizens. We are unable to consider international applicants, visa holders or candidates requiring sponsorship at this time.

Please apply only if you meet this essential requirement and the minimum criteria outlined in the advertisement. Applications that do not meet these requirements may not receive a response.

Thank you for your understanding.

job.title: Formwork labourer with FL
job.description:
Formwork Labourer – Forklift Licence Required

Location: Stones Corner, QLD

Our recruitment agency is seeking a reliable, hands-on Formwork Labourer with a current LF Forklift Licence to join our client's construction team in Wellington Point.

About the Role

This is a practical, hands-on construction role supporting formwork crews with the movement, handling and removal of formwork equipment. You'll assist with clearing and relocating gear after stripping crews finish, helping keep the site organised and work progressing safely and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist formwork crews with moving and handling equipment.

  • Help remove, clear and relocate formwork gear after stripping crews finish.

  • Operate a forklift to manoeuvre and position materials and equipment around site.

  • Provide general hands-on support to formworkers.

  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe worksite.

  • Follow site instructions and work collaboratively with the construction team.

About You

  • Previous formwork or construction labouring experience preferred.

  • Current LF Forklift Licence (essential).

  • Current White Card (essential).

  • Confident operating a forklift in a construction site environment.

  • Physically fit and comfortable with hands-on labouring and moving equipment.

  • Reliable, safety-conscious and able to work well within a team.

Key Requirement

We're looking for someone who can confidently operate a forklift while physically assisting formwork crews with moving, handling and relocating equipment.

If you have the right experience, licences and a strong work ethic, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Water proofer - Commercial - Brisbane
job.description:

You'll work alongside skilled tradespeople applying a range of waterproofing systems to commercial specifications. This is a contract role with strong hourly rates, weekly pay, and the potential for ongoing work as the project progresses. We also offer full time positions for the right people.

 

Duties

  • Apply torch-on, sheet membrane, and liquid waterproofing systems to commercial spec
  • Prepare surfaces and complete detailing to a high standard
  • Read and work from plans and project specifications
  • Maintain site safety standards and WHS compliance at all times
  • Coordinate with site supervisors on daily tasks and priorities

 

Skills & Experience

  • Proven commercial waterproofing experience — essential
  • Trade qualified 
  • White Card — mandatory
  • Working at Heights ticket — highly regarded
  • EWP or Confined Space ticket — advantageous
  • Own tools and reliable transport to site

 

Culture

Work for a company that makes you enjoy going to work. The projects are interesting and the company believes in a high standard of quality and safety.

 

Benefits

  • $50–$55 per hour based on experience
  • Weekly pay — no waiting for your money
  • Penalties and overtime rates available
  • Travel allowance paid
  • Immediate start on an active commercial project
  • Monday - Friday work
  • Will provide accommodation or travel allowance if travelling over 60kms

Direct support from Chantal and the Siteforce team throughout your placement
